newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Negara approves new directors.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara approves new directors.

text.p: Shareholders of Bank Negara Indonesia approved a new board of directors at an extraordinary general meeting on Tuesday, with Widigdo Sukarman remaining president director.
"This is a normal process," Sukarman told a news conference after the meeting, adding that there was no special purpose behind the changes.

"The difference is, previously we did not have to hold a general meeting because the government was the only shareholder. But now, as a public company, we have to hold a shareholders general meeting to get approval," Sukarman added.
He added that the format of the board remained the same, one president director and six other directors.
BNI floated 25 percent of its shares in November last year. The government retains a controlling interest.
